title: (RHBA-2020:2422) Satellite 6.7.1 Async Bug Fix Update
portal_summary: Updated Satellite 6.7 packages that fix several bugs are now available for Red Hat Satellite.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Satellite|Red Hat Satellite Capsule|6.7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For detailed instructions how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_satellite/6.7/html/upgrading_and_updating_red_hat_satellite/updating_satellite_server_capsule_server_and_content_hosts
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a system management solution that allows organizations to configure and maintain their systems without the necessity to provide public Internet access to their servers or other client systems. It performs provisioning and configuration management of predefined standard operating environments.

This update fixes the following bugs:

1810270 file repo deletion is slow
1814648 Updating the Context-Sensitive Help Links for 6.7
1826714 New version of the plugin is available: 1.0.6
1832572 Improve regenerate applicability tasks performance by querying NEVRA only data from repo_content_units
1832574 Add keep alive option in Receptor node
1832580 While using concurrency_level in remote execution, job progress in WebUI is not being updated properly
1832583 Red Hat Insights Risk Summary shows systems at risk while there are none
1832584 Unable to delete repository - Content with ID could not be found
1832586 Applying errata via Host Collection the errata are trying to be applied to all hosts associated with the host collection
1832587 Default task polling is too frequent at scale
1832588 Update distributor version to sat-6.7
1832589 After upgrading to Satellite 6.7 the Tasks page in WebUI goes "Blank"
1832590 [Regression] RedHat Insights client proxying stopped working due to missing proxy
1832593 Manifest import and delete calls Actions::Pulp::Repository::Refresh for non-Library repositories
1832594 Receptor init file missing [Install] section, receptor service won't run after restart
1832936 Get HTTP error when deploying the virt-who configure plugin
1836926 Incorrect version number on login screen for 6.7.1

Users of Red Hat Satellite are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
